notebooks.title: Welcome to ironpad
notebooks.description: Learn the basics: data flow, typed variables, and SVG charts with plotters.

notebooks.title: Async & HTTP
notebooks.description: Make HTTP requests from Rust cells using async/await.

notebooks.title: Interactive Tutorial
notebooks.description: A step-by-step introduction to ironpad features.

notebooks.title: Charts with Plot
notebooks.description: Create line, bar, and scatter charts with the built-in Plot helper.

notebooks.title: Working with JSON
notebooks.description: Pretty-print and explore JSON data with syntax-highlighted output.

notebooks.title: Interactive Widgets
notebooks.description: Build a reactive tip calculator using all six widget types: slider, dropdown, number, switch, text input, and checkbox.

notebooks.title: Shared Code
notebooks.description: Define reusable helper functions in a shared module accessible from every cell.

notebooks.title: Interactive Button
notebooks.description: Use a button widget to trigger downstream computation on demand with a slider input.

notebooks.title: Progress Bar Demo
notebooks.description: Create a progress bar and update it in real time from a downstream cell using ProgressHandle.

notebooks.title: Mandelbrot Set
notebooks.description: Zoom into the infinite complexity of the Mandelbrot fractal rendered as a color-mapped SVG.

notebooks.title: Julia Sets
notebooks.description: Explore the family of Julia set fractals by varying the complex constant parameter.

notebooks.title: Sierpinski Triangle
notebooks.description: Recursively subdivide a triangle to produce the classic Sierpinski fractal pattern.

notebooks.title: Conway's Game of Life
notebooks.description: Simulate emergent behavior with Conway's cellular automaton on a 2D grid.

notebooks.title: Rule 110
notebooks.description: Run the Turing-complete Rule 110 elementary cellular automaton and visualize its evolution.

notebooks.title: Langton's Ant
notebooks.description: Watch Langton's Ant traverse a grid, producing surprising order from simple turn rules.

notebooks.title: N-Body Gravity Simulation
notebooks.description: Simulate gravitational interactions between bodies using Newtonian mechanics.

notebooks.title: Double Pendulum
notebooks.description: Model chaotic motion with a live double pendulum simulation using the Simulation trait.

notebooks.title: Wave Equation
notebooks.description: Solve the 1D wave equation and animate propagating wave pulses using the Animation type.

notebooks.title: Ray Marching
notebooks.description: Render 3D scenes by marching rays through signed distance fields.

notebooks.title: Particle System
notebooks.description: Spawn, animate, and render thousands of particles with configurable physics.

notebooks.title: Maze Generator
notebooks.description: Generate and solve random mazes using recursive backtracking.

notebooks.title: Heat Equation
notebooks.description: Watch heat diffuse across a 2D surface in real time using the Simulation trait.

notebooks.title: Nuclear Reactor
notebooks.description: 2D neutron diffusion with 6-group delayed precursors — watch prompt vs delayed neutrons pulse through a reactor core.
